procedure_text: 步骤a：取1.1mol(134.2g)三氟乙醇钠，1.2mol(48g)氢氧化钠，1.0mol(318g)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯(化合物I)，1000mL N,N-二甲基甲酰胺加入到反应器中，然后30℃保温5小时后，将反应液中的N,N-二甲基甲酰胺减压蒸除后，将残液加入300mL水中，用35％的盐酸调pH至弱酸性，冷却结晶，过滤，水洗，干燥得化合物II，称重得314.8g，收率91％，其中，N,N-二甲基甲酰胺作为反应溶剂，还可以用己烷、环己烷、苯、甲苯、二甲苯、二氯甲烷、1,2-二氯乙烷、氯仿、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚、四氢呋喃、乙腈中的一种或多种代替。
procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide of the methyl benzoate is etherified by sodium trifluoroethoxide in N,N-dimethylformamide with sodium hydroxide present, and the methyl ester is cleaved in the same pot, so the material isolated is the free benzoic acid. The solvent is distilled off under reduced pressure, the residue taken into water and acidified, and the product crystallised on cooling, filtered, washed with water and dried.
notes: Chinese heading 步骤a. Step count agrees with A0: two steps, 步骤a and 步骤b. Reactor is printed only as 反应器 (a reactor), with no volume and no fittings, so reactor_type is recorded as "reactor" and stirring is left null; step a does not say the mixture was stirred. 保温 30℃ for 5 hours is an isothermal hold, not a heating method, so heating_method is null. One-pot: the trifluoroethoxide, the sodium hydroxide and the ester are all charged together and held once, with no workup between transformations, and the material isolated after the single workup is the free benzoic acid, not the methyl ester. Two transformations are therefore recorded in one_pot_steps: etherification of the benzylic bromide by the alkoxide, then cleavage of the methyl ester by sodium hydroxide. reaction_class is taken from the final transformation (hydrolysis) per the one-pot rule, and named_reaction names the first of the two (the alkoxide displacement of the benzylic bromide is a Williamson etherification). Confidence is medium, not high, because the prose of this section names neither transformation: the reading rests on two other pieces of evidence. First, 化合物II is a local label this section never defines, and the identifier is kept exactly as A1 recorded it (unresolved), but the specification's own summary at line 95 defines 化合物II as 2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸, the free acid. Second, the arithmetic: 314.8 g at the printed 91％ from 1.0 mol implies 345.9 g/mol, which matches the free acid C11H10ClF3O5S = 346.70 (theoretical 0.91 x 346.70 = 315.5 g against 314.8 g printed) and does not match the methyl ester C12H12ClF3O5S = 360.73 (which would require 328.3 g). An extractor that read only this section would plausibly record a single nucleophilic_substitution here; that alternative reading is recorded rather than suppressed. molar_mass_inconsistent: the ester charge 318 g / 1.0 mol implies 318.0 against C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, low by 23.6. The other two charges close: 134.2 g / 1.1 mol implies 122.0 against 122.02 for C2H2F3ONa, and 48 g / 1.2 mol implies 40.0 against 40.00 for NaOH. No mass_balance_implausible: the product mass and yield close against the free acid as set out above, and 314.8 g is below the theoretical maximum from 1.0 mol on either reading. The 35％ hydrochloric acid is a workup reagent, used to bring the aqueous residue to weakly acidic before cooling to crystallise, so its strength is carried in that compound's addition_profile rather than in conditions.concentration, and no pH number is printed. The twelve solvents listed at the end of the paragraph (己烷, 环己烷, 苯, 甲苯, 二甲苯, 二氯甲烷, 1,2-二氯乙烷, 氯仿, 1,4-二氧六环, 乙醚, 四氢呋喃, 乙腈) are alternatives to N,N-dimethylformamide and were not charged in this example, so they are not on compounds[]; A1 records them at section level. precursor_step is null: this is the first step of the route. There is no prior-section reaction registry for this run (the sections are being annotated in parallel), and none is needed here. Numbers recorded exactly as printed and not corrected.

procedure_text: 步骤b：取1mol上述反应所得的化合物II，溶解在1000mL的1,2-二氯乙烷中，然后在5-10℃温度条件下，半小时内加入含1.2mol(117.6g)1,3-环己二酮(化合物III)和1.2mol(194.6g)缩合剂CDI以及1.2mol(121.2g)三乙胺，再在5-10℃温度条件下搅拌反应8小时，然后经过水洗、减压浓缩、加甲醇打浆、过滤、干燥得到成品环磺酮(化合物IV)366.4g，纯度96.5％，收率86.3％，其中，1,2-二氯乙烷作为反应溶剂，还可以用己烷、环己烷、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺、苯、甲苯、二甲苯、二氯甲烷、氯仿、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚、四氢呋喃、乙腈中的一种或多种代替。
procedure_summary: The benzoic acid from the previous step is dissolved in a chlorinated solvent and acylates the cyclic diketone, the diketone being added at low temperature over a short period as one mixture with the condensing agent CDI and triethylamine, and the mixture then held cold. The product is washed with water, concentrated under reduced pressure, slurried with methanol, filtered and dried to the finished tembotrione.
